| description = Master Yael is found at the very bottom of [[The Hole]], the large pit which runs through the zone.

Master Yael has the innate ability to Death Touch, which will recycle every 30 seconds during a fight. Note 6/17/22 - Death Touch seems to be 45 seconds.

KoS to all players as of the 2/17/13 patch. Doesn't always see invis.

Summon nukes do not work on him even though he is an elemental.
